Frostgrave & Stargrave

Frostgrave is a fantasy skirmish game about wizards exploring a frozen ruined city, while Stargrave applies the same system to a sci-fi setting. Both are miniature-agnostic — you can use any 28mm fantasy or sci-fi figures, making them ideal for 3D printing custom warbands.

What scale am I actually printing?

Miniature Scale
28mm
Ratio Equivalent
1:56
Measurement
eye level
Eye Level Height
28.0mm

Frostgrave official miniatures (produced by Warlord Games) are 28mm true scale. The game is explicitly miniature-agnostic, so any 28mm or 32mm figures work. Stargrave leans toward 28mm sci-fi but accepts the same range. This flexibility makes both games a natural fit for 3D printed collections.

Publisher: Osprey Games / Warlord Games·Base Sizes: 25mm, 40mm, 50mm

Printing these minis on FDM

Because Frostgrave/Stargrave are miniature-agnostic, you can print anything — this is one of the best games for 3D printing experimentation. Print warbands in batches at 0.4mm nozzle and 0.08mm layers for playability. Characters and wizards benefit from 0.2mm nozzle at 0.06mm. Terrain (frozen ruins, sci-fi corridors) is a major part of the game and prints well on FDM.

All settings tested on my Bambu Lab A1 Mini with PLA. Your printer may want something different — always print a test piece first.

Frequently Asked Questions

What scale is Frostgrave & Stargrave?
Frostgrave & Stargrave miniatures are 28mm scale (1:56 ratio), measured eye level. Frostgrave official miniatures (produced by Warlord Games) are 28mm true scale. The game is explicitly miniature-agnostic, so any 28mm or 32mm figures work. Stargrave leans toward 28mm sci-fi but accepts the same range. This flexibility makes both games a natural fit for 3D printed collections.
What base sizes does Frostgrave & Stargrave use?
Frostgrave & Stargrave uses the following base sizes: 25mm, 40mm, 50mm.
What nozzle and layer height should I use for Frostgrave & Stargrave miniatures?
Because Frostgrave/Stargrave are miniature-agnostic, you can print anything — this is one of the best games for 3D printing experimentation. Print warbands in batches at 0.4mm nozzle and 0.08mm layers for playability. Characters and wizards benefit from 0.2mm nozzle at 0.06mm. Terrain (frozen ruins, sci-fi corridors) is a major part of the game and prints well on FDM.

Time to check the scale before you commit to a long print.
